commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Fabio Maresca has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Como have a goal ruled out for offside!
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Fine attempt! Simone Lottici Tessadri (Cremonese) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
88' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing.

86' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the left post.
85' Cremonese earn a corner.
85' Substitution. Federico Bonazzoli did his best and is replaced by Simone Lottici Tessadri (Cremonese).
83' Substitution. Filippo Terracciano makes way for Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
83' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Martin Baturina and he is replaced by Sergi Roberto (Como).
83' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
83' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Assane Diao is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
81' 1 - 4 Lucas Da Cunha (Como) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!

77' Assane Diao (Como) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Emil Audero anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
76' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Fabio Maresca's book.
76' Alberto Moreno goes off the pitch and Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) comes on.
74' 1 - 3 Goal! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Emil Audero to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
74' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' David Okereke (Cremonese) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
71' That was really pointless. Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Fabio Maresca no choice but to send him off.
71' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) was probably a bit loose with his words to Fabio Maresca, who decides to show him a yellow.
71' Milan Djuric (Cremonese) is given a red card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
70' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Como!
66' There's a break in play and referee Fabio Maresca must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Como using VAR. This could be interesting!
65' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Como for a penalty. Play continues.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maxence Caqueret (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Jesus Rodriguez can be given a rest.
61' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
60' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' A clever short pass gives Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
55' 1 - 2 Goal! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) lashes the penalty into the middle of the goal, giving the keeper no chance.
55' Referee Fabio Maresca is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Cremonese!
54' Celebrations by Cremonese are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
53' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. A penalty is awarded to Cremonese!
51' 0 - 2 Goal! Jesus Rodriguez shows great vision to find Anastasios Douvikas (Como) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
49' Alberto Moreno (Como) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Fabio Maresca didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
49' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Cremonese fail to score from a corner as Jean Butez (Como) leaps to collect the ball.
46' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Cremonese will have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Giampaolo decided to make a change. Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) is replaced by Michele Collocolo.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is replaced by Romano Floriani.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
42' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
36' 0 - 1 Jesus Rodriguez (Como) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Emil Audero. 0:1.

36' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Emil Audero, who makes a glorious save!
34' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
32' Jacobo Ramon (Como) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
31' Martin Baturina (Como) will deliver the corner kick.

30' He should have scored! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Assane Diao (Como) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
25' A cooling break is underway.
24' Assane Diao (Como) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
21' A yellow card for a tackle by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese). Fabio Maresca doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
19' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation.
17' Flag up against Jamie Vardy (Cremonese). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
16' Marco Giampaolo is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Youssef Maleh suffers an injury and Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) comes on.
14' The linesman signals that Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes it short.
11' Assane Diao (Como) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
10' Maximo Perrone (Como) makes a strong challenge and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
8' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
5' Alberto Moreno (Como) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
2' Maximo Perrone (Como) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
